Suggested alternative to Dieux Instant Angel?
I like Instant Angel, but I’m getting close to empty and wonder if y’all have some suggestions for alternatives I might also like.  Prefer to be in roughly the same budget, so under $75 or so?

I’m 40, dehydrated but otherwise normal skin.  Non-reactive.  I live in the tundra so right now, so can manage a heavier weighted moisturizer in the winter.

I’m also anti-tub - so if it comes in a tub, it’s not for me!

Any suggestions for things you think I might like?  TIA
